regime_context: The Canadian TSX thematic detector shows a broad-based rally (88% eligible themes) led by Base Metals & Copper (score 1.78, breadth 1.0) and a tight precious-metals cluster. Momentum rank-IC is negligible, but the absolute trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns (gate_helps true). Crowding is isolated to Insurers and Technology, neither threatening the leader. With one-narrative false and absorption moderate, the structure is not overly concentrated.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) leads with the highest momentum score and perfect breadth (1.0), indicating unified sector participation. The absolute trend gate is active (eligible, durability 0.71), historically reducing drawdown risk. While momentum rank is not alpha, the gate's risk-control property supports an overweight tilt relative to benchmark.
evidence: Trend-gate eligible and historically validated for drawdown reduction (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Base metals are cyclical and sentiment can reverse quickly; momentum rank has no forward return edge on its own.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology (XIT.TO) is deeply negative on momentum rank, crowded (crowding_z 1.07), and shows an ambiguous trend structure. Crowding is not a timing signal but a flag to downsize exposure. As a sizing caution, underweight is appropriate.
theses.dissent: Crowding can persist and may coincide with a trend that continues; underweighting may forgo further gains if tech rebounds.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the TSX by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
